title: USB device revision
description: Read the major device revision exposed for an explicitly selected USB device. No protocol transfers.

source.build: Provided by @opendevicedb/components/host; no contributor JavaScript is evaluated as a host service.

behavior: Reads deviceVersionMajor from the selected WebUSB device object. Does not open interfaces or issue transfers. Generic descriptor compatibility is not proof of product protocol support. Device selection remains explicit; no identifiers enter shared compositions or reports.
